caption: The drawing depicts a wooden keyboard instrument, possibly a small organ or harmonium, featuring a rectangular body with a closed lid and a visible set of black and white keys arranged in a single row. The instrument stands on four intricately carved, ornate legs connected by a decorative stretcher near the base, with two foot pedals extending downward from beneath the keyboard. The wood appears medium to dark brown, with some shading used to indicate texture and depth, especially on the legs and the body of the instrument. The color palette is primarily composed of various shades of brown for the wood, with the keyboard consisting of alternating black and white keys. The background is plain and beige, and there is a signature "Edna Reu" in the bottom right corner.
title: Melodeon
